transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: ConversalQ support, how can I assist?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I've been dealing with a broken webhook integration for a week. I've followed every step in your docs and it still isn't working. I need someone senior.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry you've been dealing with this for a week — that's far too long. Let me try a few things first. What error are you seeing when the webhook fires?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: It's a 500 from your server. I get the event in my logs but your system says it failed delivery.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A 500 on our end suggests a server-side processing error. Can I get your webhook endpoint URL and the event type?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I can see in our webhook delivery logs that your endpoint is returning a 500 on the fourth retry — which means we're delivering successfully but something in your endpoint is failing. Do you have server logs showing what happens when we send the payload?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Wait — you're saying it's on my side? Let me check... Oh. Our server is failing to parse the timestamp field. It's ISO 8601 but our parser expected Unix epoch.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's exactly it. Our webhook payloads use ISO 8601 format. You'll need to parse it with something like new Date() in JavaScript or datetime.fromisoformat() in Python.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I feel a bit silly. That was on our end all along.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Not at all — it's a subtle difference. For the record, I've added a note to our docs to make the timestamp format more prominent. Is the webhook working now after that fix?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Testing now... yes! Delivery succeeded. That's a huge relief.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent! Glad we got there. I won't escalate since we resolved it together. Is there anything else?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: No, I'm good. Thank you for being thorough.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Any time. Have a great day!
